address: Hẻm off Lê Quang Định, Bình Thạnh, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The matriarchs of Bình Thạnh's 'Chicken Corner' have grilled charcoal gà nướng since 1996 — smoky, juicy whole chicken, one dish done perfectly, eaten on plastic stools deep in a hẻm near the Gò Vấp border. A Saigoneer Hẻm Gems pick that Vietnam Coracle also singles out.

address: Văn Thánh Market, Ward 25, Bình Thạnh, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A sprawling local wet market in the shadow of Pearl Plaza with dozens of cheap, no-frills street-food vendors — morning bún thịt nướng grilled streetside and the Hải Phòng specialty bánh đa cua are the standouts. The subject of a dedicated Vietnam Coracle food deep-dive.
dish: bánh đa cua (Hải Phòng crab flat-noodle soup) & bún thịt nướng

address: Phan Văn Hân Street, Bình Thạnh, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A student-packed open-air food street on the District 1 / Bình Thạnh edge where single-dish stalls have specialized for 20+ years — bột chiên, bánh tráng trộn, gỏi cuốn, mì vịt tiềm and a beloved 40k-VND bún bò Huế. Mapped stop-by-stop in a Vietcetera foodie guide.
dish: bột chiên, bún bò Huế, mì vịt tiềm (street-stall row)
